Same city: Departure and arrival cities cannot be the same
Terms required: You must accept the package delivery terms
Conditions: Package must not contain prohibited items. Maximum weight: Small 5kg, Medium 15kg, Large 30kg.
Pickup date required: pickupDate is required when isImmediate is false
Past date: Pickup date cannot be in the past
Max 30 days: Pickup date cannot be more than 30 days ahead
No active package: You have no active package delivery
Not yours: This delivery belongs to another account
Already closed: This delivery is already delivered or cancelled
With driver: The parcel is already with the driver — contact support to arrange a return
Min 30 min ahead: Scheduled pickups must be at least 30 minutes from now — choose a later time or use "pickup now"
Quarter hour: Pickup time must be on a quarter-hour step (:00, :15, :30 or :45)
